families.title: Studio production suite
families.description: Lighting, UI, VFX, audio, terrain, camera, diagnostics, DataStore and NPC generators layered on execute_luau.

skills.name: lighting_set_preset
skills.description: Instantly configure production lighting & atmosphere presets: cyberpunk, sunset_warm, warm_night (warm night 20h), horror_dark, fantasy_vibrant, overcast_moody, realistic_noon, vaporwave, space_void. Configures Atmosphere, Bloom, ColorCorrection, and SunRays (assumes Future technology is set manually - do not write Lighting.Technology via Luau). Use Glare (not Glaire) and EnvironmentDiffuseScale/E

skills.name: lighting_inspect
skills.description: Inspect active Lighting properties, Technology, Atmosphere settings, and all post-processing effects in the place.

skills.name: lighting_setup_day_night
skills.description: Inject a clean, smooth Day/Night cycle controller script in ServerScriptService.

skills.name: ui_create_screen
skills.description: Create a modern, responsive ScreenGui in StarterGui configured for clean layer rendering.

skills.name: ui_create_component
skills.description: Generate styled UI in StarterGui. Types: health_stamina_hud, dialog_box, notification_toast, card_inventory, plus rewritten Forge language (forge_panel, forge_hud, forge_button, forge_inventory, forge_shop). forge:true (or the overlay Forge toggle) remaps HUDs/inventories into gold-metal Forge chrome.

skills.name: ui_inspect
skills.description: Inspect the GUI hierarchy and components currently in StarterGui.

skills.name: fx_create_emitter
skills.description: Attach high-fidelity tuned ParticleEmitter effects: fire, smoke, sparks, magic_portal, healing_aura.

skills.name: fx_create_light
skills.description: Create a calibrated light source (PointLight, SpotLight, SurfaceLight) with shadow casting.

skills.name: fx_create_vfx
skills.description: Assemble a complete composite VFX rig in one call (emitters + beams/trails + lights). Attach to a large transparent part for zone effects.

skills.name: fx_create_beam
skills.description: Create a Beam between two Attachments with texture, color, width, and segments. Auto-creates attachments if target_path is a BasePart or omitted.

skills.name: fx_create_trail
skills.description: Create a Trail with two Attachments that animates with movement. Ideal for swords, projectiles, and motion streaks.

skills.name: fx_create_explosion
skills.description: Create a real Explosion with blast pressure/radius, optional crater type, and a flash + spark VFX anchor. Works at any Vector3 or attached to a part.

skills.name: audio_setup_sound_hierarchy
skills.description: Configure industry-standard SoundService routing hierarchy: Master -> Music, SFX (Combat, Footsteps), Ambience, UI, Voice.

skills.name: audio_create_sound
skills.description: Create and configure a Sound instance attached to a Part or routed to a SoundGroup.

skills.name: terrain_fill_region
skills.description: Fill volumetric regions with voxel terrain materials (Grass, Rock, Sand, Water, Snow, Basalt, Lava, etc.).

skills.name: terrain_clear
skills.description: Clear terrain in a bounding box, or clear all terrain in the place if cframe/size omitted.

skills.name: camera_set_style
skills.description: Inject high-performance camera controllers in StarterPlayerScripts: isometric, top_down, side_scroller.

skills.name: diagnostics_audit
skills.description: Deep health and performance scan of the place: unanchored physics parts, missing humanoid roots, StreamingEnabled check.

skills.name: diagnostics_fix_common
skills.description: Automatically apply optimizations: anchor static scenery parts, enable StreamingEnabled, enable Future lighting.

skills.name: asset_bridge_import
skills.description: Import an FBX exported from Blender into Studio as Workspace.OR_Imported (EditableMesh). Pass asset = the filepath from blender_export_fbx. Also accepts rbxassetid://. Requires Connect Blender for FBX.

skills.name: datastore_setup
skills.description: Scaffolds production DataStoreService player-data with session-lock-safe UpdateAsync, pcall retry, BindToClose flush, autosave loop and optional leaderstats folder (Coins + Level).

skills.name: leaderboard_setup
skills.description: Creates an OrderedDataStore global leaderboard with a SurfaceGui board part and a LeaderboardManager ModuleScript exposing GetTop(limit).

skills.name: remote_setup
skills.description: Creates a ReplicatedStorage RemoteEvent/RemoteFunction namespace with sample server handler script. Eliminates manual Remote wiring.

skills.name: npc_spawn_pathfinding
skills.description: Spawns or reuses a Humanoid rig and injects a PathfindingService loop with CreatePath, ComputeAsync, Blocked re-compute, Jump handling and patrol/loop behaviours.

skills.name: proximity_setup
skills.description: Adds a ProximityPrompt with Billboard handling, hold duration, max distance, cooldown debounce and optional leaderstats Coins reward to any BasePart.

skills.name: tween_create
skills.description: Creates a TweenService tween on any instance property (Position, Transparency, Color3, UDim2, etc.) with EasingStyle/Direction, loop and yoyo. Generates a self-playing Script.

skills.name: marketplace_setup
skills.description: Wires MarketplaceService for a GamePass or Developer Product: UserOwnsGamePassAsync check, PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished and ProcessReceipt templates with grant hook.

skills.name: teams_setup
skills.description: Configures Teams service with coloured Team instances, TeamColor auto-distribution and an optional auto-balance assign script in ServerScriptService.

skills.name: web_fetch
skills.description: Fetches any URL via HttpService (GET) and returns the body text. Use for docs, APIs, or reference pages. Respects max_chars (500-20000).

skills.name: web_search
skills.description: Web search via DuckDuckGo HTML, returns top results as title+URL. Perfect for the AI to get a quick reference before building.

skills.name: script_analysis
skills.description: Read + lint scripts (alias: script_read_analysis). Walks SSS/StarterPlayer/StarterGui/RS/Workspace (not CoreGui). Luau block-balance (not loadstring), flags WaitForChild without timeout, bare wait/spawn/delay (not task.*), Instance.new parent arg, plus Output.

skills.name: plugin_list
skills.description: List Studio plugin surfaces: PluginGuiService, CoreGui plugin/DockWidget GUIs, PluginDebugService, and ServerStorage.RobloxScript.Plugins skeletons created by plugin_create.

skills.name: plugin_inspect
skills.description: Inspect one plugin instance (name, class, children) by dotted path from plugin_list.

skills.name: plugin_create
skills.description: Write a local-plugin skeleton under ServerStorage.RobloxScript.Plugins.<name> with a toolbar button + DockWidget script. User must Save as Local Plugin — the plugin global is not available inside execute_luau.

families.title: AgentScript extras
families.description: File helpers, JSON patching, git, npm, python/node runners mapped onto the native workspace tools.

skills.name: append_file
skills.description: Append text to a file (creates it if missing).

skills.name: copy_file
skills.description: Copy a text file to a new path (parents created).

skills.name: replace_in_files
skills.description: Replace every occurrence of query with replacement across matching files.

skills.name: touch_file
skills.description: Create an empty file if it does not exist; no-op if it does.

skills.name: file_exists
skills.description: Check whether a path exists (file or folder).

skills.name: count_lines
skills.description: Count lines in a text file.

skills.name: find_todos
skills.description: Search the workspace for TODO/FIXME/HACK comments.

skills.name: write_json
skills.description: Write pretty JSON to a path. Pass data as an object or a JSON string.

skills.name: patch_json
skills.description: Set a dotted key on a JSON file (creates nested objects as needed) and write it back.

skills.name: run_python
skills.description: Run a .py file or an inline snippet with python.

skills.name: run_node
skills.description: Run a .js file or an inline snippet with node.

skills.name: git_status
skills.description: git status -sb in the workspace.

skills.name: git_diff
skills.description: git diff (optional path).

skills.name: git_log
skills.description: git log --oneline (limit default 20).

skills.name: npm_install
skills.description: npm install, optionally a package name.

skills.name: npm_script
skills.description: npm run <script>.

skills.name: dir_size
skills.description: Sum file sizes under a folder (PowerShell).

skills.name: which_cmd
skills.description: Locate an executable on PATH (where.exe / command -v).

skills.name: concat_files
skills.description: Concatenate text files into dest.

skills.name: list_by_ext
skills.description: List files by extension (e.g. js, py, lua).

skills.name: grep_count
skills.description: Count grep hits for a query.

skills.name: scaffold_file
skills.description: Write a starter file from a tiny template (js/py/html/md/json/lua) if the path does not exist.

skills.name: read_range
skills.description: Read a slice of a text file (1-based start line, inclusive end).

skills.name: file_stat
skills.description: File/folder info (size, type) for a path.

skills.name: replace_once
skills.description: Replace the first occurrence of query in a file (leaves the rest).

skills.name: list_recent
skills.description: List files under a folder (native list_dir).

skills.name: env_info
skills.description: Workspace root + a short environment snapshot (cwd, node/python if present).
